hunk_reviews.judgment: Decline this private CDK breakpoint-observer scheduling migration after individual review of all six hunks in the complete original. All 11 static case registrations and both hooks pair in full order; every complete callback changes but all projected predicate/nonboundary sequences retain identity. Public BreakpointObserver is actually consumed by legacy autocomplete,tooltip and snack-bar; Cyph uses these legacy controls.
